project_info.theme: Cool mirror reflection in a black backless gown
project_info.color_palette: blue-gray, charcoal black, mirror silver, muted skin tones

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with long slightly tousled dark hair, refined natural features, a calm detached expression, and an elegant feminine silhouette. She wears a fitted black backless evening dress with a side slit.

items: vertical three-quarter portrait beside a large mirror above a dark marble counter
the subject turns her head back toward the camera while one hand rests on the counter
the mirror clearly repeats her back and face in a layered reflection
black backless dress, narrow straps, side slit, dark hair, and dark marble are visible
no text, logo, label, or watermark

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: cool-white practical mirror light with soft side fill, approximately 5600K
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: localized facial highlights, softened reflection edges, dimensional black satin-like fabric shadow

technical_specs.render_style: Canon EOS R5, 50mm f/1.8, slight side angle, vertical three-quarter crop
technical_specs.color_treatment: low contrast blue-gray grade, fine film grain, natural skin texture, soft background bokeh

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A vertical three-quarter high-end fashion editorial portrait of an adult woman with long slightly tousled dark hair, refined natural features, a calm detached expression, and an elegant feminine silhouette. She wears a fitted black backless evening dress with narrow straps and a side slit. Position her beside a large mirror above a dark marble counter; she turns her head back toward the camera while one hand rests on the counter, and the mirror clearly repeats her face and back in a layered reflection. Use cool-white practical mirror light with soft side fill at approximately 5600K for localized highlights, softened reflection edges, and dimensional black fabric shadow. Canon EOS R5, 50mm f/1.8, slight side angle, vertical three-quarter crop, low-contrast blue-gray grade, fine film grain, natural skin texture, and soft background bokeh. No text, logo, label, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, body measurements, text, logo, label, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use the optional source moodboard to preserve the black backless dress with side slit, dark marble counter, mirror reflection, turned head, and cool lighting. An approved-adult identity reference may replace the subject; preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness. The exact bathroom can change while maintaining an elegant mirror-layered cool editorial setting.
